claim_en: THE ADDRESSEE CENSUS. Sons not daughters; chalalim out; blemished and minors in; blood and departing impurities; the abandoned-corpse override.
THE RELATIVE TABLE. Wife; betrothed and divorced out; profaned line vs presumption; viable children; the two duty sets; paternal siblings.
THE SISTER'S CARVE. Minor sister, any-age brother, the agent-of-loss test; defilement for her a command enforced by force; certain not doubtful; no limbs.
THE HUSBAND SPLIT. Fit wife yes, unfit no; profane while occupied; Onkelos's 'great one' against the Sifra's 'husband' — a recorded fork.
MOURNING MARKS. Per spot, per gash, whole head; the two-way transfer between priests and Israel.
HOLY BY COMPULSION. Not the Levites; the blemished holy; Onkelos's offering-for-bread.
THE FORBIDDEN WIVES. Zonah three ways with Onkelos on the Sages' arm; chalalah; the rival refutes; the husband's hand; the woman warned through the man.
SANCTIFY HIM. By force; the court warned; the blemished holy.
THE PRIEST'S DAUGHTER. By whoring with a husband's bond; all ages and husbands; she burns alone; Onkelos's departure from the father's holiness.
GREATNESS AND ONE HOUR. Five greatnesses, made great from theirs; office at the pouring; rends below vs above.
THE ONEN SPLIT. Two corpses' blood; two prohibitions; hidden-and-revealed to the gate; valid for the high priest, invalid for the commoner.
THE VIRGIN COMMAND. Not king or nazirite; the war priest in; the adult disputed; betrothed-then-appointed marries; not a yevamah.
THE PROFANED SEED. Chalal not mamzer; exported down the ranks; the niddah fence; she herself profaned; the chalal's daughter.
